title: Register with Delaware EARNS or certify a retirement plan exemption
authority: Delaware EARNS (Office of the State Treasurer)
description: Employers in business at least six months with five or more employees (part-time included) and no qualified plan must register or certify an exemption; deadlines were October 15, 2024 and October 15, 2025, and June 30, 2025 for newly eligible businesses. After a notice and 90 days, the board can penalize up to $250 per eligible employee a year, capped at $5,000.

appliesWhen.description: 5 or more employees in the state

exemptions: Employers that sponsor a qualified retirement plan (they still certify the exemption)

feeDetail.note: There is no fee to file or register.

title: Train employees on sexual harassment prevention
description: Employers with 50 or more employees must give interactive training to new employees within one year of hire and refresh it every two years, with extra training for supervisors.

appliesWhen.description: 50 or more employees in the state

feeDetail.note: The cost depends on the training provider and the number of employees.
